Name: Janas hijabs and turbans
Author: janamods01
Description:
Adds some colorful hijabs and turbans as hats. Best worn with less volumous hairstyles.

29/05/20 - Added looser fit turbans to the main files, and three more specific designs as optional files. [Feel free to tell me if any of the designs are disrespectfully wrong, as I don't actually know some of them irl. Please refrain from telling me if they're just ugly, I'm but a humble not-artist.]
Delete the old version before installing this one, otherwise you'll have duplicates.
